issues.where: the lava river behind the left animal, upper left
issues.what: -a has a broad, bright lava flow pouring down the far slope and spreading across the plain behind the animals, which is the main light source; -b keeps only a thin, short squiggle that stops high on the slope, so the backdrop is dark rock with no orange source
issues.fix: bring back the wide falling lava stream and its pool across the mid-ground, glowing strongly and lighting the fume around it

issues.where: the whole sky and background cliffs
issues.what: -a is filled with thick warm smoke and an orange-lit haze that softens the cliffs; -b is clearer and greyer, the left cliff wall reads as a flat, sharp grey texture and the right butte is crisp and cool
issues.fix: add dense warm volcanic fume across the background, lit orange from below, and push the cliffs back into it

issues.where: the foreground and mid ground floor
issues.what: -a has many bright molten cracks and pools across the floor, glowing hot under the feeding mouth and in a long seam at lower right; -b has fewer, thinner, dimmer cracks and the floor reads as cool grey crust with rocks
issues.fix: widen and brighten the molten seams, add a glowing pool under the mouth and the lower-right seam, and warm the crust near them

issues.where: the floor surface in the lower right and centre (see set-B-02 crops)
issues.what: the -b crust shows a repeating, combed, wavy stripe texture with a silvery sheen and scattered tiled rocks; -a is a soft, rough, matte basalt
issues.fix: replace with an irregular matte basalt crust without the striated pattern or the cold highlights

issues.what: in -a the root-like mouthparts glow bright orange from the lava they touch; in -b they are pale grey-white and lit only at the very tips
issues.fix: let the lava under-light the tendrils up their length in warm orange

issues.where: the right animal and its lifted foot
issues.what: -a shows the lifted foot as a disc shedding falling grit and the animal sits in orange haze; -b loses the falling grit and the animal stands against a crisp grey cliff
issues.fix: restore the debris falling from the raised foot and set the animal in warm fume

issues.what: -b adds several distinct white steam plumes rising from the ground which are not in -a, and they read cool against the warm scene
issues.fix: remove the isolated white plumes or replace them with low warm drifting fume as in -a

issues.what: -a bodies catch warm rim light from the lava; -b bodies are lit flatly and greyer
issues.fix: add warm orange rim light on the lava-facing sides

issues.where: the cave mouth and cliff face
issues.what: in -a the cave is a deep dark tunnel framed by rock glowing orange only on its inner lip; in -b the arch is a smooth, banded orange shell like a lit bowl, and the cliff above is a flat, sharp, cool grey texture with no haze
issues.fix: make the arch rough rock lit only near the lava, deepen the tunnel, and soften the cliff with warm haze

issues.where: the lava cascade down the bench
issues.what: -a has a lava fall that splits into many fine braided rivulets down a stepped ledge and fans into a wide, crackled delta; -b is a narrower, smeared stream with wavy stretched texture and a smaller fan
issues.fix: break the flow into braided, branching channels over stepped rock and widen the delta at the base

issues.where: the rock bench beside the lava (see set-B-04 top crops)
issues.what: -a has glowing lava threads running through the rock to the left of the main fall and a warm cast on the stone; -b rock beside the flow is grey and unlit, with a stretched wavy lava edge
issues.fix: add the side seams of lava through the rock and let the flow warm the stone around it

issues.where: the left scree slope (see set-B-04 bottom crops)
issues.what: -a slope is crisp dark basalt with light-edged angular fragments; -b slope is a muddy, low-contrast brown with a few large smooth blocks
issues.fix: add contrast and small angular light-edged rubble, darker basalt tone

issues.what: -a has a dark soft foreground with one long glowing crack leading in; -b has a flat reflective band with horizontal orange streaks and no lead-in crack
issues.fix: restore the single glowing crack across the foreground and a dark matte rough floor

issues.where: the far animals at the lava's edge
issues.what: -b animals are slightly larger and placed further right on the delta; the left one is half lost in the lava glow
issues.fix: set them smaller at the delta's right edge, silhouetted against the glowing haze
